    • Method Detail

      • onDiscoveredAlreadyPairedButton

        void onDiscoveredAlreadyPairedButton(Flic2Button button)
        Called when the user holds down a button that is already paired to the manager. This will be called at most one time per button per scan.
        Parameters:
        button - the button

      • onDiscovered

        void onDiscovered(String bdAddr)
        Called when a new button is discovered that the user holds down for at least 6 seconds. This will be called at most once per scan. The next callback will be onConnected(), or onComplete(int, int, Flic2Button) in case of failure.
        Parameters:
        bdAddr - the Bluetooth device address of the device

      • onConnected

        void onConnected()
        Called when the Bluetooth connection has been established to the previously discovered button. A pairing attempt to this button will now be initiated. The next callback will be onComplete(int, int, Flic2Button).

      • onComplete

        void onComplete(int result,
                int subCode,
                Flic2Button button)
        Called when the scanning has finished for any reason, unless scanning was explicitly stopped.
        Parameters:
        result - result code, see Flic2ScanCallback and Flic2ButtonListener for a list of codes.
        subCode - a subcode
        button - if RESULT_SUCCESS, the button object that is now both connected and ready
